about: Hand-kept: the EIA petroleum series (PET.zip) printing each Statistical Abstract table's rows (Phase 5; the rows each table prints, at the finest frequency EIA prints them), by EIA series id. lib/eia-series.js names and labels them from EIA's own names. `name` and `units` are EIA's, copied from the bulk file when the list was made (lib/eia-series.js reads them so the list never depends on the data folder).
